name: create-product-demo-video
description: Records a product demo video of a real user flow in whatever web app your repo contains. Claude reads the actual routes, components and design tokens, transcribes them into a self-playing HTML demo, and records it to mp4 (or gif) with Playwright + ffmpeg, optionally over a normalized music bed. Ships four caption styles, a 1280x800 mock-browser skeleton, and a recorder that asserts the audio mux instead of trusting it.
